CommerceReturns.title: Returns
CommerceReturns.description: Find the original sale by date, choose its receipt, then record exactly which items came back and what should happen next.
CommerceReturns.findReceiptHelp: Choose the date the sale happened. TEED will show the active receipts recorded during that local calendar day.
CommerceReturns.itemsCount: {count, plural, one {# sold item} other {# sold items}}
CommerceReturns.noSalesForDate: No active sales were found for this date.
CommerceReturns.selectItemsHelp: Enter a return quantity only for the items that came back. Previously returned quantities cannot be returned again.
CommerceReturns.independentStockHelp: This item was sold independently of TEED stock, so a return will not automatically make it available inventory. Receive it into stock separately if needed.
CommerceReturns.notSellable: Do not return to sellable stock
CommerceReturns.historyHelp: Recent recorded returns stay linked to their original sale receipt.
CommerceReturns.emptyHistory: No returns have been recorded yet.
CommerceReturns.searchError: Receipts for this date could not be loaded.
CommerceReturns.saveError: The return could not be recorded.
CommerceReturns.chooseItemError: Enter a return quantity for at least one item.
CommerceReturns.reasonError: Enter the reason for this return.
